Upstream: https://github.com/Cap-go/hybrid-ui/
Upstream main commit at vendoring time: 94f69b14c17bf8719bd3bac4ce83f4e8dc9fd10f

Local patches in this vendor copy (not on upstream main yet):
- ios/Sources/HybridUiPlugin/HybridUiSlotContentRegistry.swift
- ios/Sources/HybridUiPlugin/HybridUiOverlayHost.swift (registry attach, refreshSlot, slot content notification)
- android/build.gradle (buildscript before plugins for Gradle 9)
- android/.../HybridUiCompositorSession.kt (viewportRect rename for Kotlin JVM signature)

Consuming via public git or npm is not used here because hybrid-ui is private and these patches are required for video slot attach.
